description: The content-section catalogue — the closed set of section types a page may hold and a template may render. Section type = content KIND (coarse); layout/variant is the template's job. Additive-only: types and fields are added, never removed or re-shaped, within a contract major. Every section is independently omittable — a template must degrade gracefully when any subset is absent.

fields.description: How this hero offers giving: 'form' (default) places the donation widget beside the copy; 'button' renders copy only — the primary button becomes the giving path (defaulting to /donate). Templates MUST render both.
